subject.title: fix(gateway): preserve pending replies on forced restart

question: Should `openclaw gateway restart --force` remain an immediate no-wait escape hatch, or become a bounded best-effort drain that waits up to 5 seconds for pending replies?
rationale: The bug fix is narrow, but it changes an operator-facing restart contract that current help and docs describe as immediate.

options.title: Accept bounded force drain
options.body: Merge only after live pending-reply proof and help/docs make the new 5 second best-effort drain contract explicit.

options.title: Keep force immediate
options.body: Pause this PR and solve pending-reply preservation through safe restart, deferred restart, or another non-force path.

options.title: Make bounded drain opt-in
options.body: Ask for a separate explicit option or mode if maintainers want to preserve current `--force` semantics by default.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded force drain
recommendation.body: Merge only after live pending-reply proof and help/docs make the new 5 second best-effort drain contract explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans gateway operator UX and adjacent restart lifecycle history where this owner has recent related involvement.
